stories.title: Taillon Rocked Again — Rotation Spot in Jeopardy, 25 HRs Allowed (Most in MLB)
stories.angle: Taillon gave up 7 ER and 3 HRs in 4 IP Sunday — now at 25 HRs allowed (tied most in baseball). Counsell won't commit to his next start. Seven days to the deadline. The rotation crisis is a 5-alarm fire.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Taillon allowed 7 ER and three HRs Sunday. He's now given up 25 home runs — tied for the most of any pitcher in baseball.

Counsell won't commit to his next start. Seven days to the deadline. The rotation need just became impossible to ignore.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

research.facts:
Taillon Rocked Again — Rotation Spot in Jeopardy, 25 HRs Allowed (Most in MLB)
**Sources:** Chicago Sun-Times (July 26), Bleacher Nation enhanced box score (July 26), Cubs Insider recap (July 26), Cubbie Crib (July 26), Yardbarker (July 26)
**Key Facts:**
- July 26 outing vs. Pirates: 4 IP, 7 ER, 3 HRs allowed
- O'Hearn grand slam (3rd inning) extended lead to 7-1; Pirates also got 2 HR from rookies Valdez and Ross in 2nd inning
- Cubs nearly came back — Suzuki 2-run HR in 9th made it 8-7 — but Mason Montgomery held on for Pittsburgh
- 2026 season totals: 2-6 record, 5.38 ERA before Sunday (career-worst entering start); ERA rises after 7 ER in 4 IP
- 25 home runs allowed in 2026 — tied for most by any pitcher in baseball (per Chicago Sun-Times)
- Counsell postgame: "I think we've got to discuss it, yeah. We've got days to figure that out, but we have to discuss what's best for the staff in general."
- Taillon quote: "I'm hurting the team"
- Taillon is in the last year of a 4-year $68M deal
- Astros reportedly interested in acquiring Taillon via trade
research.sources: - Source confidence: HIGH (multiple outlets confirm game facts and direct quotes)

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

research.facts:
Bullpen Update — Palencia Returning, Kelly Emerging at Iowa
**Sources:** Bleed Cubbie Blue (Taillon activation / Civale addition), FanGraphs RosterResource injury report, MLBTradeRumors (Antoine Kelly), Cubbie Crib (prospect update), DaWindyCity.com
**Key Facts:**
- Daniel Palencia: 15-day IL, right flexor strain. "On track to return before end of July" per multiple reports. Cubs' primary closer.
- Phil Maton: 15-day IL, right knee tendonitis — also expected back soon
- Antoine Kelly (LHP): Acquired from Dodgers in minor-league deal, June 2026. Iowa stats: 0.84 ERA in ~13 IP, ~27% K rate, fastball approaching triple digits. Multiple reports say callup is imminent.
- Aaron Civale added to active roster; Drew Pomeranz DFA'd in recent transactions
